messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx + latency anomaly on cluster rfw-prod-3. Affected tenant: crescentai (org_31245). 5xx ratio > 4% sustained over 4m. Please acknowledge and triage.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): acknowledged. Jumping in. Alex, do we have a breakdown by route?

Alex (eng-runtime): main pressure on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/generate-stream. Runtime logs show repeated "kv cache eviction overflow" and occasional shard OOM on worker-7. Pattern: many short bursts of large-context requests (prompt + max_tokens often > 7000).

Priya (SRE-Oncall): paging CS now. This is customer-visible?

customer-success: paging CrescentAI eng lead. They report increased errors and automatic retries. Some of their background batch jobs started running concurrently with interactive traffic.

Marta (eng-runtime): I see queue growth at the proxy layer; proxy returns 503 when backend queue > 800ms. Also runtime is rejecting allocation with error: "alloc failed: kv-cache-limit-reached".

Priya (SRE-Oncall): mitigation proposal: 1) apply emergency org-level QPS cap for org_31245; 2) temporarily block requests with extremely long total token counts (>6000); 3) flip off non-critical heavy memory feature for the org. Any pushback?

Jordan (Platform): +1. Recommend conservative caps to avoid client-side thundering retries. We'll coordinate a gradual ramp if needed.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): applying emergency cap now via admin tool. Command and output below.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): ```bash
# emergency cap: bring org down to 5qps with burst 10 for safety
rictl org-quota update --org org_31245 --qps 5 --burst 10 --note "emergency mitigation 2026-11-05"
```

Priya (SRE-Oncall): result: 
> updated quota policy qp-20261105-09 -> org_31245
> effective: immediate

ops-bot: :gear: Quota policy applied: qp-20261105-09 -> org_31245 (qps=5, burst=10). Logged by Priya.

Alex (eng-runtime): also pushed a short routing isolation to move org_31245 traffic onto the org-isolate-pool for 20m to reduce cross-tenant spillover. Command: 

Alex (eng-runtime): ```
rictl route add --org org_31245 --pool org-isolate-pool --ttl 20m --reason "isolate heavy tenant during spike"
```

Priya (SRE-Oncall): isolation applied. Monitoring now (give it 90s).

Marta (eng-runtime): noticing a lot of requests with header x-req-tokens > 7000. Proposing a temporary request gate: reject when (prompt_len + max_tokens) > 6000 for this org with 429 and clear message to client.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): apply size gate. Paste rule below.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): ```json
{ "org": "org_31245", "max_total_tokens": 6000, "response_code": 429, "message": "temporary size limit: reduce max_tokens or shorten prompt" }
```

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Size gate enforced for org_31245.

customer-success: notified CrescentAI of the emergency caps and size gate. Asking them to pause heavy background batches and confirm when they're reduced.

Alex (eng-runtime): metrics 3m after mitigations: org qps down ~82%. Backend 5xx fell from 4.3% -> 0.6%. p99 latency went from 2.8s -> 1.0s. Memory pressure on worker-7 dropping. Looks promising.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): good. Additional step: disable experimental feature "rewrite-assist" for the org to lower memory churn. Marta, can you toggle?

Marta (eng-runtime): toggling now.

Marta (eng-runtime): ```bash
rictl feature-flag update --org org_31245 --flag rewrite-assist --enabled false --reason "emergency memory mitigation 2026-11-05"
```

ops-bot: Feature flag changed: rewrite-assist=false for org_31245.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): creating incident record INC-20261105-31245 and assigning owners for follow-ups: postmortem to EngRuntime + Platform. I'll hold the incident for 45m then hand to Night Oncall (Alex).

Alex (Night-Oncall): acknowledged handoff. I'll keep an eye and will only rollback after sustained stability (30m).

customer-success: CrescentAI confirms their ops team paused scheduled jobs and dialed down retries; they see much fewer errors. Appreciate the quick action.

Jordan (Platform): note for postmortem: consider introducing an automatic short-circuit that reduces max_total_tokens per org when we detect repeated "kv-cache" evictions to prevent cascading OOMs.

Marta (eng-runtime): saving traces and sample request IDs to INC-20261105-31245. Will produce per-org token distribution and eviction heatmaps.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): summary for ticket: emergency qps cap + size gate + feature toggle + routing isolation applied; customer notified; system stabilized. Keeping policies active for monitoring.

incident-bot: INC-20261105-31245 status updated -> stabilized (sev2). Next automated check in 20m.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): will remain reachable for 30m, then hand final watch to Alex (Night-Oncall). Please add any follow-ups to the incident.

Alex (Night-Oncall): will draft a brief customer-facing blurb tomorrow and collaborate on the postmortem.

customer-success: noted. We'll coordinate customer comms once postmortem draft is ready.

Priya (SRE-Oncall): handoff complete, signing off on channel. Thanks all :hands_together:
